name: Erik Erikson
shortBio: German-American psychoanalyst and developmental psychologist who formulated the epigenetic eight stages of psychosocial development and coined the 'identity crisis'.
centralQuestion: How does the human ego navigate sequential, culturally mediated psychosocial crises across the entire lifecycle to forge ego identity and virtues?

keyWorks.title: Childhood and Society
keyWorks.description: Outlines the eight stages of psychosocial development from basic trust to ego integrity.

keyWorks.title: Young Man Luther: A Study in Psychoanalysis and History
keyWorks.description: Pioneers psychohistory by analyzing Martin Luther's acute identity crisis and historical transformation.

keyWorks.title: Identity: Youth and Crisis
keyWorks.description: Systematizes adolescent identity formation, psychosocial moratorium, and identity confusion.
